_: The one source of the countdown. Only its digits and colons are ever on screen. It shows `start` (hours:minutes:seconds) from the moment its signal locks (clockOriginFrame in config/timeline.json) and counts down one second a second. The film is a prerecorded, deterministic animation, not a live clock.
display: ceil: a value is on screen for the whole second that ends at it, so the start shows 22:22:22 and one second later 22:22:21
